description: This file contains a static extension class for configuring Orleans silos to use event data generator streams. It defines an extension method for ISiloBuilder to add event data generator streams with configuration options.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to facilitate configuration related to event data generator streams.

methods.name: AddEventDataGeneratorStreams
methods.description: Extension method that adds and configures event data generator streams for the silo using a provided configuration action.
